import pandas as pd

# File paths for the source CSV files
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_50/test_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_50/test_1.csv"

# Load Source 0
# Schema: ['ocd_prop_id', 'calaccess_prop_id', 'ccdc_prop_id', 'prop_name', 'ccdc_committee_id', 'calaccess_committee_id', 'committee_name', 'committee_position']
df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0, dtype={
    'ocd_prop_id': str,
    'calaccess_prop_id': 'Int64',
    'ccdc_prop_id': 'Int64',
    'prop_name': str,
    'ccdc_committee_id': 'Int64',
    'calaccess_committee_id': 'Int64',
    'committee_name': str,
    'committee_position': str
})

# Load Source 1
# Schema: ['calaccess_committee_id', 'committee_name', 'calaccess_filing_id', 'date_received', 'contributor_lastname', 'contributor_firstname', 'contributor_city', 'contributor_state', 'contributor_zip', 'contributor_employer', 'contributor_occupation', 'contributor_is_self_employed', 'amount']
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0, dtype={
    'calaccess_committee_id': 'Int64',
    'committee_name': str,
    'calaccess_filing_id': 'Int64',
    'date_received': str,
    'contributor_lastname': str,
    'contributor_firstname': str,
    'contributor_city': str,
    'contributor_state': str,
    'contributor_zip': str,
    'contributor_employer': str,
    'contributor_occupation': str,
    'contributor_is_self_employed': bool,
    'amount': float
})

# Rename columns in df0 to match target schema where needed:
# committee_name in df0 corresponds to committee_name_x in target
df0 = df0.rename(columns={'committee_name': 'committee_name_x'})

# Rename columns in df1 to match target schema where needed:
# committee_name in df1 corresponds to committee_name_y in target
df1 = df1.rename(columns={'committee_name': 'committee_name_y'})

# Join df0 and df1 on calaccess_committee_id to combine committee info and contributor info
# This join is a left join on df0 to keep all proposition-committee info and attach contributor info where available
# But since target examples show multiple rows per prop-committee with different contributors, an inner join is appropriate
df_merged = pd.merge(
    df0,
    df1,
    how='inner',
    on='calaccess_committee_id',
    suffixes=('_x', '_y'),
    validate='m:m'  # many-to-many join expected
)

# After merge, df_merged columns:
# ['ocd_prop_id', 'calaccess_prop_id', 'ccdc_prop_id', 'prop_name', 'ccdc_committee_id', 'calaccess_committee_id',
#  'committee_name_x', 'committee_position', 'calaccess_filing_id', 'date_received', 'contributor_lastname',
#  'contributor_firstname', 'contributor_city', 'contributor_state', 'contributor_zip', 'contributor_employer',
#  'contributor_occupation', 'contributor_is_self_employed', 'amount', 'committee_name_y']

# Select and reorder columns to match target schema exactly:
target_columns = [
    'ocd_prop_id',               # from df0
    'calaccess_prop_id',         # from df0
    'ccdc_prop_id',              # from df0
    'prop_name',                 # from df0
    'ccdc_committee_id',         # from df0
    'calaccess_committee_id',    # from both
    'committee_name_x',          # from df0 (renamed)
    'committee_position',        # from df0
    'committee_name_y',          # from df1 (renamed)
    'calaccess_filing_id',       # from df1
    'date_received',             # from df1
    'contributor_lastname',      # from df1
    'contributor_firstname',     # from df1
    'contributor_city',          # from df1
    'contributor_state',         # from df1
    'contributor_zip',           # from df1
    'contributor_employer',      # from df1
    'contributor_occupation',   # from df1
    'contributor_is_self_employed',  # from df1
    'amount'                    # from df1
]

df_final = df_merged[target_columns]

# Ensure data types match target schema exactly:
df_final = df_final.astype({
    'ocd_prop_id': str,
    'calaccess_prop_id': 'Int64',
    'ccdc_prop_id': 'Int64',
    'prop_name': str,
    'ccdc_committee_id': 'Int64',
    'calaccess_committee_id': 'Int64',
    'committee_name_x': str,
    'committee_position': str,
    'committee_name_y': str,
    'calaccess_filing_id': 'Int64',
    'date_received': str,
    'contributor_lastname': str,
    'contributor_firstname': str,
    'contributor_city': str,
    'contributor_state': str,
    'contributor_zip': str,
    'contributor_employer': str,
    'contributor_occupation': str,
    'contributor_is_self_employed': bool,
    'amount': float
})

# Export the final dataframe to CSV
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_50/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_final.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
